Super Sega 8-bit machine core (milestone 1, untested on hardware).

Runs Master System and Game Gear software on the Super Sega machine model:
Z80, Mode 4 VDP (192/224/240 lines, Game Gear CRAM), PSG, Sega, Codemasters
and Korean mappers, cartridge saves. Super Sega titles run, but ESAT, the
window and text layers, line tables and unique-cell mode are not drawn yet.
SG-1000/SC-3000 software loads but the TMS9918 picture modes are not drawn
yet, and there is no FM sound yet.

ROMs go in /Assets/supersega/common/. Pocket B = button 1, A = button 2,
Y = auto-fire for button 2 (with that boost on), Select = Pause. In Super
Sega mode the pad is a Mega Drive pad: B = B, A = C, Y = A, Start = Start,
so buttons 1 and 2 stay on B and A. A docked USB keyboard is the SC-3000
SK-1100 keyboard.

Boost options in the core settings are the machine's enhancement layer. All
are off by default, which is stock behaviour, and they act only on Master
System, Game Gear, SG-1000 and SC-3000 software, never on Super Sega titles.
